propositions: Three CLI verbs (rebar bridge-fsck, rebar bridge-probe, rebar jira-onboard) must be renamed to new canonical noun-based spellings (rebar bridge fsck, rebar bridge check-access, rebar bridge setup) while maintaining backward compatibility.
Old verb spellings must remain functional as compatibility entrypoints that delegate to identical implementation paths without forking behavior, state, or exit policy.
All enumerated in-tree consumers (CLI, help files, schemas, tests, scripts, workflows, documentation) must be systematically migrated to use new canonical spellings.
Bridge setup must call bridge check-access as its final validation step while preserving environment overlay behavior and the --no-validate escape hatch.
Schema metadata (both $id and description fields in bridge_fsck.schema.json) must be updated to reflect new verb naming and updated in contract tests.
